description: §6.8.4 rule 2: a `reset-on=` entry that is not a declared, mutable, non-derived cell — here a derived cell — is E-RESET-ON-INVALID-ENTRY.
rationale: §6.8.4 rule 2: "Every entry SHALL be a declared, mutable, non-derived reactive cell in scope at the declaration … An undeclared name, a non-`@` name or a derived cell is **E-RESET-ON-INVALID-ENTRY**; an empty list (`reset-on=[]`) is the same error." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "3b: `reset-on=` IS allowed on engine cells, checked against `rule=`" — "the new rec for engine reset, yes."
